repos.name: browser-use/browser-use
repos.description: 🌐 Make websites accessible for AI agents. Automate tasks online with ease.
repos.one_liner: A powerful Python library that enables AI agents to interact with and navigate websites as humans do.
bullets: Built on Playwright for robust browser automation and DOM interaction.
Provides a standardized interface for LLMs to execute complex web-based workflows.
Ideal for automating data extraction, web testing, and agentic research tasks.
Supports multi-step navigation, form filling, and dynamic content handling.

repos.name: coding-kitties/investing-algorithm-framework
repos.description: Framework for quantitative trading. Complete framework for development, backtesting, and deploying automated trading algorithms and trading bots.
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive Python framework designed for developing, backtesting, and deploying quantitative trading strategies.
bullets: Modular architecture supporting data ingestion, strategy logic, and execution.
Includes built-in backtesting engines to validate trading performance against historical data.
Supports live trading integration with various exchanges and broker APIs.
Designed for systematic traders looking to automate portfolio management and execution.

repos.name: calesthio/OpenMontage
repos.description: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files. Turn your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.
repos.one_liner: An open-source, agentic video production system featuring extensive pipelines and production-knowledge libraries.
bullets: Orchestrates over 700 agent skills and 100+ specialized production tools.
Utilizes a multi-agent architecture to handle complex creative and technical video workflows.
Automates end-to-end production from conceptualization to final rendering.
Highly extensible framework for integrating AI-driven content generation into professional pipelines.

repos.name: LilMGenius/paperthin
repos.description: Low-level agentic design patterns. Turning old engineering wisdom into reflexes your agent reaches for on its own—on any agent.
repos.one_liner: A library focused on low-level agentic design patterns to improve agent reasoning and decision-making reflexes.
bullets: Implements foundational engineering patterns for agentic systems.
Focuses on 'reflexive' behavior, allowing agents to access pre-defined wisdom during execution.
Framework-agnostic design, compatible with various existing agent architectures.
Aims to reduce hallucination and improve reliability in complex task-solving environments.

repos.name: tailscale/tailcat
repos.description: like netcat, but over Tailscale's data plane, without Tailscale's control plane
repos.one_liner: A network utility that provides netcat-like functionality over the Tailscale data plane without requiring a central control plane.
bullets: Leverages Tailscale's peer-to-peer mesh networking for secure, encrypted communication.
Simplifies cross-network connectivity for infrastructure debugging and data transfer.
Operates as a lightweight binary, ideal for DevOps and infrastructure troubleshooting.
Provides a secure alternative to traditional netcat for sensitive internal network operations.
